name: Oats Marie Thinz
ingredients_raw: Whole Wheat Flour(Atta), Sugar, Rolled Oats (10%), Refined Palm Oil, Invert Sugar Syrup, Milk Solids, Raising Agents [INS 503(ii), INS 500 (ii)], Honey, Emulsifier of Vegetable Origin (INS 471e), lodised Salt, Natural, Nature Identical (Honey) and Artificial Flavouring Substances (Milk and Vanilla), Dough Conditioners [INS 223, INS 1101(1)]. Allergen Advice: Contains Wheat, Oats and Milk May contain traces of Nut.
